comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus hand off and carry a level rack of open sample cups.
comparison.physical_skill: Long rigid-part regrasping, latching and fastening versus mid-air bimanual handoff with spill-preventing attitude control.
comparison.success_condition: Self-supporting attached rail versus cups upright and rack level, transferred to the far pad.
comparison.reason: Shared long-object support and leveling are generic; transport/handoff without tipping is not structural installation. Candidate force and allowable-level-error thresholds are missing.
